I haven't run these against the NAS-Bench-201 data. The numbers below are priors based on the benchmark's general behavior: conv ops outperform pooling and skip, and "none" removes a path. Claim 2 is the most plausible because replacing a missing edge with a conv gains more than replacing a weaker op. Claim 29 is low because the edit downgrades a 3x3 conv to a 1x1 conv.
